content.comment_body: Is it possible to adjust a timer value using the Text Display? I am working with a [product_name] and a Text Display. If it's doable, what's the procedure?

Hello [user_name], You might find this example useful. It shows how to use the Text Display's function keys to increase or decrease a setpoint value. Reviewing this could be helpful for your scenario. Best regards [user_name]

To set the timer setpoint, compose a message that includes it. When displaying the message, press the ESC button continuously until a cursor appears. Then, select OK and use the arrow keys to adjust the value.

I believe [user_name]'s solution is more user-friendly. Its advantage is that you can also begin the online test using [product_name] software. If an incorrect project is made, you directly update it on the [product_name], which can lead to discrepancies between the projects on the device and PC, preventing online monitoring. Nevertheless, either approach can work.
The provided example does not modify a timer value. I'm specifically looking to change settings for a Delay Off or Delay On Timer.

If you want to use the F keys as [user_name] suggested, the example changes a counter value. You can use this counter value in various function blocks by referencing it in the block's properties. Most timer functions as well as many analog blocks support referencing a counter value.
